$description: The voice takes of the website recorded films (Qwen3-TTS preset voice Ryan): what each says (its spoken form), what Whisper base.en heard, the word error rate against the spoken form, the prepared take length and its fingerprint. Recogniser differences are mostly numbers written as digits and names misheard; see docs/media/QWEN_TOUR_NARRATION.md.

replacementRule: One new take from the same spoken form when the recogniser hears a sound before the first word that is not in the line, or the speech runs under 0.8 written words a second with no pause to explain it. Each replaced take was replaced once; all five new takes say their lines.
